projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chengalpattu district, Thiruporur taluk) · Village: Egattur · Pincode 603103 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. RERA TNRERA/35/BLG/0115/2026 confirmed verbatim on both roofandfloor and nobroker, and the 100-unit registry figure is corroborated by the marketing line 'boutique development with just 100 exclusive homes' (the '100' in the project name). Roofandfloor gives an internally consistent base set: 2BHK 1245-1248sqft = Rs.1.03-1.04Cr, 3BHK 1355-1938sqft = Rs.1.12-1.60Cr; my recompute lands on 8,266-8,273/sqft, matching its quoted 8,273 — this tier is clean. Rs.8,270/sqft is credible as the Egattur base rate; ~Rs.12,000 as all-in for sea-view stock. TWO UNRESOLVED CONFLICTS: (1) total units — nobroker and the marketing say 100 (agrees with RERA), roofandfloor says 271; (2) land area — nobroker says 6.00 acres, roofandfloor says 3.42 acres, so I left land_area_acres null rather than pick arbitrarily. The dataset name 'ATH THE MERLION changed to ATH MEADOWS' matches the promoter's live project ATH MEADOWS at Madambakkam exactly. RERA TNRERA/35/BLG/0304/2025 printed on findbhk's ATH Meadows page. ALL per-sqft figures RECOMPUTED, and the recomputation caught a bad field: findbhk QUOTES Rs 8,500/sqft, but its own price table gives 99,00,000/990 = Rs 10,000, 1,04,00,000/1031 = Rs 10,087 and 1,20,00,000/1230 = Rs 9,756 — the quoted Rs 8,500 is wrong and was discarded. Promoter's own range recomputes to 95,00,000/990 = Rs 9,596 and 1,52,00,000/1520 = Rs 10,000. So the true band is Rs 9,600-10,100/sqft. Ticket range Rs 95 L - Rs 1.52 Cr is the promoter's (wider than findbhk's Rs 99 L - Rs 1.20 Cr, which covers only three of the configurations). MATERIAL CONFLICT ON IDENTITY: roofandfloor (id 6893) and chennaiproperties (id 6934) both attach this SAME RERA number to 'ATH Merlion', 45 G+1 VILLAS on 2.68 acres at Kovur/Kundrathur, Rs 99.69 L - Rs 2.16 Cr, ready Apr 2026. I resolved in favour of ATH Meadows Madambakkam because (a) the RERA zone code is 35, whereas both confirmed Kundrathur registrations in this batch carry zone 1, so 0304 cannot be a Kundrathur project; (b) the dataset records a RERA name change to ATH MEADOWS, which only the Madambakkam project satisfies; (c) Rajakilpakkam and Madambakkam are adjacent, consistent with the Tambaram zone. The roofandfloor/chennaiproperties pages appear to have mis-stamped the villa listing with this registration.

projects.name: Adityaram Palace City Paradise
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Sholinganallur taluk) · Village: Sholinganallur · Pincode 600119 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. Locality corrected from Sholinganallur to Panaiyur: TNRERA records the revenue village, which differs from the marketed micro-market here. Gated palace-themed independent-villa community, not apartments. SOURCES DISAGREE MATERIALLY ON RATE — full range recorded, nothing averaged. Two clusters: (1) ~Rs 15,240-15,840/sqft from Squareyards (Rs 2.50 Cr/1,641 sqft = 15,235; Rs 3.71 Cr/2,435 = 15,236; Rs 4.46 Cr/2,927 = 15,238; Rs 8.91 Cr/5,846 = 15,241 — internally airtight) and Quikr (Rs 2.60 Cr/1,641 = 15,844). These pages carry the 2023-vintage RERA numbers (TN/29/Building/0208/2023, /0243/2023, TN/29/Layout/1271/2023) and possession dates of Apr 2023 / Dec 2026 — i.e. they are the EARLIER, largely completed phase. (2) ~Rs 19,900-20,833/sqft from findbhk, which is the ONLY source keyed to OUR RERA number TNRERA/29/BLG/0241/2026: Rs 5 Cr for a 2,400 sqft 4BHK and Rs 10 Cr for a 4,800 sqft 5BHK — both recompute to Rs 20,833/sqft against a quoted Rs 19,900. PropertyPistol independently supports the high cluster (Rs 2.44 Cr onwards, ~Rs 20,333/sqft recomputed). The promoter's own site says 'Rs 5 Crores onwards', matching cluster (2). CONCLUSION: the current 2026-registered phase is selling at ~Rs 20,000-20,800/sqft with tickets of Rs 5-10 Cr; the Rs 15,200-15,800 figures are stale listings for the older phase. I have set ticket to the current phase (500-1000 lakh) but note that older-phase listings still show Rs 2.44-8.91 Cr. All figures are ASKING. Note also the portals report 80 villas (Quikr/findbhk) vs 87 (Squareyards) — I used 80. VILLA, not apartment. Adityaram Palace City is a gated palace-themed independent-villa community. The promoter's own site lists only villa tiers (Ultra Luxury 4,800-5,975 sqft, Luxury 2,400-3,600 sqft, Twin 2,067 sqft, Elite 1,640-2,434 sqft). Some portals mis-tag it as 'apartments' — they are wrong.

projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district) · Pincode 600119 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. Nine ground-plus-first residential villa blocks per TNRERA, not apartments. PROJECT POSITIVELY IDENTIFIED, PRICE NOT DIRECTLY PUBLISHED — the per-sqft figures here are INFERRED, not quoted for Royal. TNRERA record for TNRERA/29/BLG/0217/2026 confirms name 'ADITYARAM PALACE CITY ROYAL', promoter M/s Adityaram Housing Private Limited, 9 dwelling units (matches the registry record exactly), 3,344.81 sq.m FSI, completion 13-Mar-2031, construction not yet started. NO portal, aggregator or promoter page carries a Royal-specific price — I searched and fetched and found none, and I have not invented one, hence null tickets and null unit sizes. The rate band shown is the SAME-DEVELOPMENT rate for Adityaram Palace City's current 2026-registered phase (RERA 0241/2026: Rs 19,900/sqft quoted, Rs 20,833/sqft recomputed from Rs 5 Cr/2,400 sqft and Rs 10 Cr/4,800 sqft). Royal sits on the same land parcel under the same promoter, so it should price in or above that band — 'Royal' branding plus ~4,000 sqft of FSI per unit points to the Ultra-Luxury tier, which could push it HIGHER than Rs 20,833/sqft. Do not present this rate to a buyer as a Royal quote. Also note the very long runway: Mar 2031 completion on a 9-unit scheme that has not broken ground. VILLA, not apartment. TNRERA describes it as nine Ground Floor + First Floor residential buildings on individual plots.

projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Mylapore taluk) · Village: Mylapore · Pincode 600018 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. Locality corrected from Mylapore to Abhiramapuram: TNRERA records the revenue village, which differs from the marketed micro-market here. TREAT THE PRICE RANGE AS UNRELIABLE AND PROBABLY UNDERSTATED — I am recording it only because the field would otherwise be empty. RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0049/2026 is CONFIRMED on both Square Yards and NoBroker, and unit sizes 1,926-3,018 sqft / 10 units / 0.22 acres are solid. But the developer publishes 'Price on Request' everywhere; no source anywhere gives a total ticket for a specific unit, which is why ticket_min/max are null. The Rs 12,400/sqft figure is Square Yards' 'average asking price as of Jun 2026' and Rs 15,300/sqft is NoBroker's 'average' — both read as locality/portal index values rather than project rates, and BOTH conflict sharply with better evidence: (a) the promoter's own site banners 'Rs 5.5 Crs onwards' (Rs 4 Crs onwards on the ongoing-projects page), which against the 1,926 sqft entry unit implies roughly Rs 21,000-28,500/sqft; (b) Amara's own sibling projects in comparable central pockets RECOMPUTE far higher — Amara Advika Royapettah 4,18,00,000/2238 = Rs 18,677/sqft, Amara Arya T Nagar 6,34,00,000/3022 = Rs 20,979/sqft, Amara Aneja T Nagar Rs 22,613/sqft. Abhiramapuram is at least as expensive as Royapettah. I did NOT average and did NOT take the low end — the honest reading is that the real rate is likely Rs 19,000-28,000/sqft and the portal figures are stale index values. Do not surface Rs 12,400/sqft to a buyer without this caveat.

projects.name: Amara Alaaya
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Aminjikarai taluk) · Village: Koyambedu · Pincode 600107 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0047/2026 confirmed on chennaiproperties and nobroker (nobroker lists it as builder RERA ID); 136 units matches the registry exactly. BRAND vs SPV: registry promoter is Sunhera Realty Private Limited; portals market it as 'Sunhera Amara Alaaya' or under 'Amara Homes'/'Amara Constructions' — same project, Sunhera appears to be the SPV behind the Amara brand. MAJOR UNRESOLVED PRICE CONFLICT, recorded as a full range and NOT averaged. Source A (chennaiproperties): 3BHK 2,049-2,156sqft = Rs.3.05-3.2Cr, 4BHK 3,278-3,294sqft = Rs.4.65-4.68Cr; my recompute = Rs.14,185-14,885/sqft, internally consistent. Note the same page's headline range reads 'Rs.3.5Cr-4.68Cr', inconsistent with its own per-config detail starting at 3.05Cr; I used the per-config figure. Source B (proplocators, a tier-3 lead-gen microsite): 3BHK 2,018-2,111sqft, 4BHK 3,213-3,257sqft, Rs.4.99-7.99Cr; my recompute = Rs.24,532-24,727/sqft, also internally consistent. The two sources differ by ~1.66x — this is a genuine conflict, not a rounding artifact. TRAP CAUGHT: proplocators and nobroker both display 'Rs.38,652/sqft', which reconciles with NEITHER source's ticket prices and is roughly 2.6x the low read — a bogus per-sqft field of exactly the kind flagged for sulekha. I discarded it entirely. My assessment: the ~Rs.14,200-14,900/sqft read is far more plausible for Koyambedu (locality base ~Rs.9,000-13,000/sqft, and this is premium tower stock), while Rs.24,600/sqft would be Boat Club/Poes Garden territory and is not credible on Poonamallee High Road — but I have not silently taken the low end, and the buyer-facing range should stay Rs.3.05-7.99Cr until a promoter source settles it. Sunhera Realty has no findable official website. Also note nobroker labels the project 'Ready to Move', which contradicts a 2026 RERA registration and a Jul 2029 possession date — treat that field as unreliable. Nobroker's smaller sizes (3BHK 1,291-1,364; 4BHK 2,045-2,068) are CARPET areas, not a fourth size conflict; the ratio to saleable is a normal ~1.59x.

projects.name: Casagrand Avenue Park
projects.notes: B+G+5 structure, 2/3/4 BHK. BEST-SOURCED RECORD IN THIS BATCH — confirmed on the PROMOTER'S OWN SITE (casagrand.co.in) with RERA TN/29/Building/0419/2024 matching our record exactly, plus RoofAndFloor corroboration. Unit count 209 and land 4.02 acres agree across both. SOURCES DISAGREE ON RATE, so I recorded the full spread. RoofAndFloor quotes Rs 9,099/sqft and Rs 2.75-2.76 Cr for the 2,939-2,955 sqft 4BHK; recomputing that myself gives Rs 9,340-9,357/sqft, close to its quoted rate. Casagrand's own site quotes a 'base rate' of Rs 9,499/sqft but a ticket range of Rs 1.85 Cr to Rs 3.15 Cr+; recomputing Rs 3.15 Cr against the largest 2,955 sqft unit gives Rs 10,660/sqft, and Rs 1.85 Cr against the smallest available 3BHK Pinnacle (1,666 sqft) gives Rs 11,105/sqft. The gap between the advertised base rate and the quoted tickets is the usual Casagrand pattern of a headline rate that excludes car park, amenity, and statutory charges. I have set the band Rs 9,099-10,660 (quoted floor to recomputed all-in ceiling); the true all-in rate is at the top of that band or above. Casagrand's own site claims a market comparable of Rs 12,000/sqft — that is a marketing benchmark, not evidence. WATCH: with 195/209 sold, remaining inventory is thin and skewed to the 4BHK Pinnacle, so entry at the low end of the ticket range is likely unavailable. Asking rates only.

projects.name: Casagrand Holachennai
projects.notes: Construction ~10% complete as of March 2026 per portal listing. Mixed township — 94 of 1,818 units are floor villas rather than flats. CONFIRMED ON THE PROMOTER'S OWN SITE with RERA TN/29/Building/0352/2024 matching our record exactly, and corroborated by RoofAndFloor (1,818 units, 29.50 acres, Oct 2027 possession). I CAUGHT THE HEADLINE-RATE TRAP HERE — do not use the advertised figure. Both Casagrand's own site and RoofAndFloor splash 'Rs 7,999/sqft', but that rate is contradicted by Casagrand's OWN unit-by-unit price table on the same page. Recomputing every row myself: Rs 1.10 Cr / 1,174 sqft = Rs 9,370; Rs 1.45 Cr / 1,588 sqft = Rs 9,131; Rs 2.28 Cr / 2,532 sqft = Rs 9,004; Rs 3.41 Cr / 3,794 sqft = Rs 8,988. Every configuration lands in a tight Rs 8,988-9,370/sqft band — roughly 12-17% above the advertised Rs 7,999, and squarely on the Rs 9,000/sqft that Casagrand itself lists as the 'market price'. The Rs 7,999 is a teaser. Third-party aggregators are worse still and should be ignored: PropertyPistol says Rs 4.82K/sqft, findbhk Rs 5,599, PropLocators Rs 7,999 — none reconcile with the published ticket table. Ticket band Rs 1.10 Cr - Rs 3.41 Cr is taken directly from the promoter's own configuration table. Entry 3 BHK (1,472-1,476 sqft) and the 4 BHK villa are already sold out. Asking rates; nothing transacted. Predominantly apartments, but this is a MIXED township — 94 of the 1,818 units are floor villas or independent villas. The registry's 'apartment' tag is right for the bulk of it but understates the product mix.

projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district) · Village: Mylapore · Pincode 600028 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. RERA MISMATCH INVESTIGATED AND RESOLVED: both portals display TN/29/Building/0305/2024, NOT the 0281/2025 on this record. I chased it down — proquiro and verified.realestate both index TNRERA/29/BLG/0281/2025 under the name 'ETICA MALAR MRC NAGAR' by Etica Developers, described as a REVISED planning permission for the high-rise. So 0281/2025 is the re-registration of the same project previously carried as 0305/2024, and the portal pricing legitimately attaches to this record. MATERIAL CONFLICT ON THE TOP END, recorded in full rather than averaged: housing.com gives Rs4.93Cr-Rs12.74Cr over 2053-4245 sqft; SquareYards gives Rs4.83Cr-Rs9.66Cr over 2100-4200 sqft. Per-sqft recomputed by me: housing 4.93Cr/2053 = Rs24,014 and 12.74Cr/4245 = Rs30,012; SquareYards computes at a flat Rs23,000/sqft across all sizes, which is the signature of a portal back-filling from a single assumed rate rather than a real price list — I weight housing's differentiated figures higher. By far the most expensive project in this batch, consistent with MRC Nagar being top-tier Chennai. Only 14 units on 0.3 acres.

projects.name: Kaadosh Cullinan
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Alandur taluk) · Village: Adambakkam · Pincode 600088 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. BEST-EVIDENCED PRICE IN THIS BATCH — three independent portals agree within a few percent. RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0123/2026 confirmed on all of them and 66 units matches the TNRERA description exactly (input had total_units null). All rates RECOMPUTED by me from price divided by area: chennaiproperties Rs.1.49-2.18 Cr on 1141-1671 sqft = Rs.13,059 and Rs.13,046/sqft; SquareYards Rs.1.48-2.17 Cr on the same sizes = Rs.12,971 and Rs.12,986/sqft; Houssed Rs.1.55-2.30 Cr = Rs.13,585 and Rs.13,764/sqft against saleable area. The quoted headline rates (chennaiproperties "13,058", SquareYards "12,999") both check out against their own tables — unusually, no trap here. Note Houssed lists CARPET areas of 1073-1575 sqft for the same units, versus 1141-1671 sqft saleable elsewhere. TNRERA completion is 31.03.2029; portals say Dec 2028 (Houssed) and Mar 2029 (SquareYards) — I used the RERA date. Land area 0.34 acres is corroborated by two sources but implies a very high FSI for 66 units; the TNRERA text does confirm "Availing Premium FSI with TOD Benefit", which supports it. Site is Pazhandi Amman Koil Street and Karneegar Street, Adambakkam. WORTH FLAGGING FOR THE SCORING MODEL: SquareYards' own "Price Insights" index claims this project averages Rs.7,750/sqft — 40% below its OWN published asking price of Rs.12,999 on the same page. That index is unusable as a price signal and I used it nowhere in this batch.

READ THIS BEFORE USING THE PRICE - IDENTITY IS NOT FULLY CONFIRMED. Russel Foundations' own website (russelfoundations.com/lionsgate) shows exactly ONE Lions Gate: Agaram Main Road, Thiruvanchery, Madambakkam/Selaiyur, 1.62 acres, but registered as TN/01/Building/0070/2023 with 131 units. Two readings are possible: (a) the 2026 registration is a re-registration/extension of the same Madambakkam development with a revised unit count, or (b) it is a distinct later phase on adjacent land. I could not resolve which - the promoter site lists no second Lions Gate and no 2026 RERA number. The pricing recorded here (Rs 6,500/sqft, Rs 71.57L-1.43Cr, 1,101-2,202 sqft, launched Feb 2023) belongs to the 2023-registered 131-unit project per housing.com. If reading (b) is correct, this price is attached to the WRONG registration and a 2026 launch would price above a Feb 2023 launch. Treat as an indicative Madambakkam benchmark for this promoter, not a confirmed price for TNRERA/35/BLG/0127/2026. Promoter name matches exactly; the 14-party owner list in the record is consistent with the JV structure typical of these developments.

projects.name: Liverpool
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Madhavaram taluk) · Village: Madhavaram · Pincode 600060 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. STRONG IDENTITY MATCH: squareyards reports 120 units, which matches the record's total_units EXACTLY, plus promoter Raunaq Foundations and locality Madhavaram. Marketed as 'Raunaq Liverpool'. 2 & 3 BHK, 1,071-1,530 sqft (squareyards), Milk Colony Road. PER-SQFT SPREAD IS REAL AND I DID NOT COLLAPSE IT: findbhk quotes a headline Rs 7,500/sqft AND a ticket band of Rs 82L-1.35Cr. Those two are not fully consistent with squareyards' sizes - I recomputed both endpoints myself: 82L/1,071 = Rs 7,656 and 135L/1,530 = Rs 8,824. So the implied transacted-ask band is roughly Rs 7,650-8,825, ABOVE the Rs 7,500 headline rate. I set price_sqft_min to the quoted 7,500 floor and max to my recomputed 8,824 so the record spans the genuine disagreement. SOURCE QUALITY CAVEAT: the only per-sqft and ticket figures come from findbhk, a tier-3 lead-generation microsite, and such sites publish stale teaser rates - the ceiling figure in particular is weakly sourced. Sizes/unit count from squareyards (tier-2) are more reliable. No promoter website for Raunaq Foundations surfaced. I did not see RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0079/2026 printed on any portal page, so RERA linkage is inferred from name+promoter+locality+unit count.

Name and promoter match exactly: the promoter's own site (novalifespace.in) markets 'Nova Platinum 64' and Houssed carries it as 'Nova 64 Platinum' by Nova Lifespace / Nova Life Space Pvt. Ltd. Possession 30-Nov-2026 is only months away, which fits a nearly-complete small block rather than a 2025 new launch.

IMPORTANT NEGATIVE FINDING — a name-collision trap I deliberately did not fall into: Arima Builders' well-marketed "Arima Chiron Villa" at Kanathur Reddikuppam (5 BHK villas, Rs 1.84-2.84 Cr, 2700-4050 sqft) is a DIFFERENT project carrying RERA TN/35/Building/006/2024, not TNRERA/35/BLG/0348/2025. Same promoter, same village — so it would have been easy to attach Chiron Villa's prices to this record. Do NOT do so. As a locality reference only, Chiron Villa recomputes to Rs 5,897-6,914/sqft (1.84Cr/3120 and 2.80Cr/4050) — and note squareyards printed that project's rate as "Rs 58,974-69,136/sq.ft", a textbook 10x portal error. The registry's cost fields for 0348 were internally inconsistent in the mirror (land Rs 65 L + construction Rs 3.5 Cr does not reconcile with a stated Rs 41.5 Cr total), so I recorded no cost figure at all.

The quoted 19,500 is most likely a base construction rate before car parking, amenities, corpus and statutory charges; the Square Yards 15,200 I cannot account for at all and would discard. Rs 23,200/sqft is credible for prime Royapettah. One data-hygiene warning: chennaiproperties prints the RERA as TNRERA/26/BLG/0053/2026, which is wrong - RoofandFloor's TNRERA/29/BLG/0051/2026 matches the registry. Asking rates, not transacted.

projects.name: Sagar The One
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chengalpattu district) · Pincode 600100 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. Rate recomputed by me, and it exposes a base-vs-all-in gap within a single source: RoofAndFloor states Rs 90L 'all-inclusive' AND a Rs 7,083/sqft rate, but 7,083 x 1,200 = Rs 85.0L, whereas 90L / 1,200 = Rs 7,500/sqft. The consistent reading is a base price near Rs 85L and an all-in price of Rs 90L; I recorded that full span rather than picking one. Housing.com independently corroborates the top of it — 'starts from Rs 90.0 L onwards'. MAJOR COMPLETION-DATE CONFLICT, UNRESOLVED: RoofAndFloor markets possession as December 2026, while the TNRERA filing gives a proposed completion of 17 July 2033 — nearly seven years apart. The RERA date is the outer legal commitment and is the safer planning assumption; the Dec 2026 marketing date looks aggressive for a project registered only in April 2026, even at 20 units. Do not publish Dec 2026 without a caveat. Also note a spurious config claim: a NoBroker listing snippet advertises '1, 2, 3 & 4 BHK' — that is boilerplate. RoofAndFloor, MagicBricks, Housing.com, PropLocators and the RERA record all agree on 20 units of 3BHK only. Identity confirmed: RERA TNRERA/35/BLG/0144/2026 matches exactly, promoter Sagar Grandhi Constructions matches, 20 units matches the tracked record. CMDA planning permission 18 Jul 2025; Perumbakkam Village Panchayat building permission 11 Dec 2025; registered 25 Apr 2026. Land: RERA says 700 sqm (0.173 acres), RoofAndFloor says 0.180 acres — trivial discrepancy, RERA figure recorded.

PRICE CONFLICT (base vs all-inclusive), recomputed by me, both ends recorded: RoofAndFloor publishes base prices of Rs 77L-1.09 Cr over 1,003-1,401 sqft — recomputes to Rs 7,677/sqft and Rs 7,780/sqft, matching their stated Rs 7,599-7,749 band. projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Chennai taluk) · Village: Tondiarpet · Pincode 600081 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. NO PRICE, AND NO PORTAL PRESENCE AT ALL — this project does not appear on RoofAndFloor, Housing, SquareYards, NoBroker or MagicBricks; the only substantive record I could retrieve is the TNRERA filing. There is a likely structural reason: the RERA filing states the developer retains 9 of the 16 flats (units 102, 104, 106, 201, 203, 205, 301, 303, 305), which is the signature of a joint-development/landowner-share arrangement where the remaining 7 go to the landowner. A project split that way often sells through local channels only and never gets a portal listing, so the absence of a price is expected rather than a research gap. DO NOT MISREAD THE ONE MONEY FIGURE ON RECORD: the RERA filing declares a total project cost of approximately Rs 7.26 crore. That is a declared construction/development cost, NOT a sales value and NOT convertible into a per-sqft selling rate — dividing it by area would produce a badly understated number. I have deliberately left all price fields null. Identity confirmed: RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0262/2025 matches exactly, promoter Elite Housing (a partnership firm) matches. Registered 04 Aug 2025; proposed completion 30 Jun 2027.

projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district) · Pincode 600015 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. RERA MATCH EXACT (TNRERA/29/BLG/0161/2026), corroborated by chennaiproperties, CommonFloor and the Proquiro RERA mirror. Per-sqft RECOMPUTED, not copied: 2.79Cr/1551 = Rs 17,988 and 3.32Cr/1846 = Rs 17,984 — the two ends agree to within 4 rupees, so the price list is internally coherent. SOURCE CONFLICT WORTH FLAGGING: SquareYards shows this project as 'Price on Request' and displays Rs 10,050/sqft (up from Rs 8,900 in Mar 2026) — that is the Sri Nagar Colony LOCALITY trend rate, not the project rate. Do not average it against Rs 17,988; a boutique 18-unit Guindy tower legitimately prices at ~1.8x the locality mean. Also note total units is reported as both 18 (portals) and 'site extent 993.76 sqm'; RERA declared project cost is Rs 37.23 Cr, which at 18 units = Rs 2.07 Cr/unit of cost against a Rs 2.79-3.32 Cr ask — a plausible margin, which supports the price band. Registry promoter string is long (Sreshta Cityscapes Pvt Ltd + individuals); portals variously credit 'Sreshta Premium Developers Pvt Ltd' and 'Sreshta Sumanth And Co' — same Sreshta group, name not standardised.

projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Mambalam taluk) · Village: Kodambakkam Part 2 · Pincode 600083 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. projects.name: Sri Vidya
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Chennai taluk) · Village: Arumbakkam · Pincode 600106 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. Two independent sources (JLL Homes and ChennaiProperties) both give Rs 2.70 Cr, and both carry the matching RERA number TNRERA/29/BLG/0334/2025 — identity is solid. Unit size 1,600 sq ft comes from JLL Homes; recomputed rate = Rs 2,70,00,000 / 1,600 = Rs 16,875/sq ft. TRAP AVOIDED: ChennaiProperties publishes 'unit size 5,649 Sq.Ft' and 'rate per sqft 4,780' for this project — 5,649 sq ft is actually the LAND area (0.13 acre) mis-filed into the unit-size field, and their 4,780 rate is 2.70 Cr divided by that wrong number. Both of those ChennaiProperties figures are garbage; do not use them. Rs 2.70 Cr is a starting price, so the top of the range may be higher. Rs 16,875/sq ft is at the premium end for Arumbakkam and reflects Pushkar's boutique positioning.

projects.name: Tejas
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Mylapore taluk) · Village: Mylapore · Pincode 600086 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. IDENTITY CONFIRMED: two sources carry RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0113/2026 verbatim, matching the input exactly; 10 units and Vishranthi Homes Pvt Ltd also match. This is an ultra-luxury boutique — 10 units of 4 BHK on 1 acre in Mylapore, possession Dec 2030. MATERIAL CONFLICT ON TICKET SIZE — RECORDED AS A FULL RANGE, NOT AVERAGED. All three sources agree on the RATE to within Rs 12/sqft (~Rs 41,982-41,994), but they disagree on which AREA that rate is applied to, which swings the headline price by 57%: chennaiproperties and squareyards both publish Rs 11.44 Cr on 2725 sqft (recompute: 11.44Cr/2725 = Rs 41,982, exact), while nobroker publishes Rs 17.94 Cr and lists super built-up 4272 sqft (recompute: 17.94Cr/4272 = Rs 41,994, exact). Note that the 2725 sqft figure sits within 1% of nobroker's CARPET area of 2691 sqft, so the low quote appears to be rate x carpet while the high quote is rate x super-built-up. Standard Indian sale practice prices on saleable/super-built-up area, which argues the realistic ticket is nearer 17.94 Cr — but I did not silently take either end. Two independent sources back 11.44 Cr and one backs 17.94 Cr. Verify the area basis with the promoter before publishing a single figure. At Rs ~42,000/sqft this is at the very top of the Mylapore band and is the single highest-rate asset in this batch.

projects.name: Temple Ridge
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Ayanavaram taluk) · Village: Ayanavaram · Pincode 600023 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. MATERIAL SOURCE CONFLICT — three different rates published, I did not average them. (1) ChennaiProperties, which carries the matching RERA number TNRERA/29/BLG/0082/2026, quotes Rs 14,000/sq ft and Rs 1.49-2.34 Cr; this is internally consistent (1,065 x 14,000 = 1.49 Cr; 1,675 x 14,000 = 2.34 Cr) and is what I led with. (2) Proplocators quotes Rs 12,800/sq ft and Rs 2.17-2.60 Cr, but its own numbers do not reconcile with its own unit sizes and it cites a different RERA number (TN/29/Building/0017/2024), so treat it as loosely corroborating the ~13k band only. (3) SquareYards, also RERA-matched, quotes Rs 8,100/sq ft (2 BHK Rs 86.26 L, 3 BHK Rs 1.11-1.35 Cr) and labels the project 'Ready to Move' — I recomputed and its figures are internally consistent at 8,100, but that rate is far below the Ayanavaram market and the 'ready to move' label contradicts every other source including the promoter, so I judge it a stale auto-generated base rate and excluded it from the band. The recorded 12,800-14,000 band and Rs 1.49-2.34 Cr ticket range are asking prices. All sources agree on 30 units, ~0.45-0.46 acre and the five unit sizes, so this is one project, not a name collision. Possession also conflicts: Dec 2028 (ChennaiProperties/SquareYards) vs 08 Jul 2026 (Proplocators); I used Dec 2028. Promoter's own site publishes no price.

projects.name: The President By Asta
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Mylapore taluk) · Village: Mylapore · Pincode 600004 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. IDENTITY CONFIRMED to the exact RERA number TNRERA/29/BLG/0288/2025 (M/s Sapthrishi Buildcon Private Limited), matched on TNRERA and NoBroker: 79 units on both, completion 12-May-2032 on both. SOURCES DISAGREE MATERIALLY ON PRICE — full range recorded, deliberately NOT averaged. NoBroker quotes Rs 10 Cr - Rs 11.05 Cr, which I recompute against its own areas as Rs 10 Cr / 3,800 sqft = Rs 26,316/sqft and Rs 11.05 Cr / 4,200 sqft = Rs 26,310/sqft — internally consistent to within Rs 6/sqft, a strong sign the numbers are real. A second cluster (Quikr/CommonFloor-style listings surfaced in search) says Rs 5-8 Cr, which against the same areas implies only Rs 13,158-19,048/sqft. I JUDGE THE HIGH CLUSTER MORE CREDIBLE, for three reasons: it is the only one that reconciles with its own stated areas; it matches the RERA completion date exactly while the low-cluster page also botched land area (0.16 acres vs TNRERA's 7,092.50 sq.m = 1.752 acres); and Rs 13,000/sqft on RK Salai for a triple-basement ultra-luxury tower is implausibly cheap when the same promoter is asking Rs 16,400/sqft in Vadapalani, a materially cheaper micro-market. Treat Rs 26,300/sqft as the working figure and Rs 5 Cr as a stale or teaser floor. Land area: NoBroker says 2.00 acres vs TNRERA's 1.752 acres (patta extent) — I used the TNRERA figure. Asking rate; nothing here is transacted.

I DISCARDED AddressOfChoice's Vesta listings entirely: it reports unit sizes of 7,800-12,200 sqft against tickets of Rs 35-103 lakh, implying absurd rates of Rs 454-972/sqft — it has confused project land area with unit size. Textbook tier-3 garbage; do not use that source for this promoter.

ARC Vivenza by ARC Developers is confirmed real with a promoter page and listings on both SquareYards and 99acres; SquareYards' builder page prices it Rs 67.55 lakh to Rs 73.37 lakh as a new launch. ARC's portfolio spans wildly different price points (ARC Alcazar Nungambakkam at Rs 4.40-7.34 Cr, ARC Noor Pearl Adyar at Rs 3.60-4.20 Cr), which is a likely source of the spec-table bleed on their site. Locality corrected from Vadakadambadi Panchayat to Mahabalipuram: TNRERA records the revenue village, which differs from the marketed micro-market here. 32 ground-plus-one 3BHK villas, registered under the building stream. NO PRICE FOUND — deliberately left null rather than inferred. Identity is solidly confirmed: lifeatziva.com publishes RERA TNRERA/35/BLG/0236/2026 against Ziva Mohanam with 32 villas, 3BHK, 1,520 sqft, ground+1, under construction, bookings open. But neither the promoter nor any portal publishes a Mohanam price — I checked lifeatziva (4 pages), arunhomes.in, chennaiproperties, twofoldproperty, connectionpoint, propji, propguider, jeevinseniorcare, and search snippets from 99acres/commonfloor/squareyards/nobroker. The only villa comparable on the same campus is Ziva Amritavarshini: Rs 2.25-2.27 Cr over 1,950-1,960 sqft, which recomputes to Rs 11,538-11,582/sqft. Applying that rate to 1,520 sqft would suggest roughly Rs 1.75 Cr — I am stating that ONLY as a comparable-derived expectation in this note and have NOT written it into the price fields, because it is my arithmetic on a different project, not a quoted price for Mohanam. Sales line +91 7288872888 is the route to a real number. VILLAS, not apartments. Mohanam is 32 ground-plus-one 3BHK villas, registered under the TNRERA building stream. The record's type 'apartment' should be corrected to villa/independent house.

projects.expected_completion: October 2028 to February 2029 for the under-construction phase
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chengalpattu district, Tambaram taluk) · Village: Arasankalani · Pincode 600126 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. Identity CONFIRMED — NoBroker lists BOTH TN/01/Building/0399/2022 (dated 10/10/2022) and TNRERA/35/BLG/0296/2025 (dated 08-09-2025) against this project, so the record's registration is a NEW PHASE of an existing township, not a new project. Promoter Krishnaiah Projects Pvt Ltd is the BSCPL Infrastructure group (formerly B. Seenaiah & Company (Projects) Ltd, promoted by Bollineni Krishnaiah's family) — the record's promoter and the marketed brand are the same entity. STAGE IS SPLIT and this matters: the promoter's own site shows possession June 2024 under the older TN/01/Building/0458/2020 registration (that inventory is ready), while NoBroker shows under construction to February 2029 and findbhk reports only 10 percent complete as of 30 January 2026 with handover expected October 2028. So ready stock and a 2028-29 phase are being sold side by side, which is also why rate_basis is 'mixed'. PRICES — full range recorded, conflict NOT averaged away, all per-sqft recomputed by me: SquareYards (June 2026) gives Rs 59.29L-1.10Cr over 885-1,650 sqft, recomputing to Rs 6,699 and Rs 6,667/sqft; the promoter's own site gives Rs 71L-1.15Cr over 1,040-1,660 sqft, recomputing to Rs 6,827 and Rs 6,928/sqft. Those two are the internally consistent sources and they bracket Rs 6,670-6,930/sqft. Two further sources sit outside that: NoBroker quotes Rs 80L-1.45Cr but against CARPET areas of 652-1,040 sqft (not comparable to the super-built-up figures above), and findbhk quotes Rs 90L-1.38Cr at a stated Rs 6,599/sqft which does not divide out against any published size. The ticket floor of Rs 59.29 lakh is likely ready-phase inventory and the Rs 1.45 crore ceiling likely new-phase large units — do not read the span as a single price list.

projects.name: “Lancor Ananya”
projects.notes: TNRERA registry record (Chennai district, Mylapore taluk) · Village: Mylapore · Pincode 600004 · Pricing not published in the registry — verify with the promoter. RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0194/2026 dated 08-06-2026 confirmed on Lancor's own project page. NO PRICE IS PUBLISHED anywhere — developer site, 99acres (403-blocked), Housing, MagicBricks, SquareYards, Houssed and AddressOfChoice all omit it, so price_sqft and ticket are left null rather than inferred. For context only (NOT a project quote), Lancor's own market commentary puts Alwarpet/Mylapore at ₹17,000–24,400/sqft with ultra-luxury pockets beyond ₹29,000/sqft. Warren Road address; developer flags 'Only 1 Unit Available', so it is effectively sold out. Lancor is BSE/NSE-listed with a 41-year on-time delivery record and claims one of the earliest handovers among central-Chennai 2026 luxury launches. Imported marble, twin stretcher lifts, 100% backup, EV charging for every apartment, pool, gym, party hall, double-height lobby. Identity confirmed on the PROMOTER'S OWN SITE (lancor.in), the best-tier source: RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0194/2026 dated 08.06.2026, Warren Road Mylapore, 48 residences, 3&4BHK 1,271-2,448 sqft, 4 units/floor — 48 units matches the record exactly. NO PRICE PUBLISHED: Lancor does not disclose a rate, and 99acres shows 'Price On Request'; I left all price fields null rather than infer. The likely reason is commercial, not an oversight — the promoter states only 1 unit is still available, so the project is effectively sold out and no live price list is being marketed. Benchmarks only, NOT this project's price: Mylapore flats average ~Rs 18,450/sqft, and a separate listing shows 3BHKs on Warren Road starting ~Rs 2.06 Cr — neither is attributable to Lancor Ananya. Note the promoter page carries a stray pincode 600119 for a Mylapore (600004) address, an evident website typo.
projects.score_rationale: Scores on close to upcoming metro/infrastructure.
